|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">任意の反乱軍か戦士に配備する。ホス上では、そのキャラクターは戦闘力と没収値が＋１となり、「凍傷」、「凍死」、「雪嵐」の影響を受けなくなる。</span>
|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">エコー基地の兵員が着用、携帯する防寒具。ホスの過酷な環境での活動と生存能力を高める。</span>
|translation='''Title''' — [[Hoth Survival Gear]].

'''Lore''' — Cold-weather gear worn and carried by Echo Base troops. It improves their ability to operate and survive in Hoth's harsh environment.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on any Rebel or warrior. While on Hoth, that character is power and forfeit plus 1 and is immune to Frostbite, Exposure, and Ice Storm.
|translation_note=Named cards print as 凍傷, 凍死, and 雪嵐. The Japanese face prints deploy 1 and uses アイテム for the device subtype.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothsurvivalgear.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth Survival Gear]].</ref>
